question: According to the signed works contract, when did the works start, and when is their completion planned?
expected_answer: The works started on 23 February 2026 and last 12 weeks; completion is planned on 15 May 2026 (article 3 of the works contract signed on 10 February 2026).

question: Under the signed works contract, how much deposit did the clients pay at signature, and what amount is withheld as the retention guarantee?
expected_answer: The deposit is 30 % of the price including VAT: 13483,08 €, paid at signature on 10 February 2026 (article 4). The retention guarantee (retenue de garantie) is 5 % of the price including VAT: 2247,18 €, released one year after handover if no reserves remain open (article 5).
notes: Asked by the accountant. S2: articles 4 and 5 of the contract. Amendment n°1 applies the same 5 % retention to its 2328,00 € (derived, not printed: 116,40 €).

question: What is the current total contract price of the works, excluding and including VAT?
expected_answer: 39783,00 € excluding VAT and 47271,60 € including VAT: the works contract signed on 10 February 2026 at the price of quote DEV-2026-014 indice B (37843,00 € excluding VAT, 44943,60 € including VAT) plus amendment n°1 of 10 March 2026 for the roof window and the exterior socket and light (1940,00 € excluding VAT, 2328,00 € including VAT). question: What did the clients ask to add to the works after signing the contract, and how much does each addition cost, excluding VAT?
expected_answer: In their e-mail of 4 March 2026, Séverine and Aymeric Moreau asked for a roof window above the dining area of the extension, if possible fitted together with the roofing, and for an exterior socket and a wall light with a detector on the terrace side. question: When will the windows of the extension be delivered?
expected_answer: The sources disagree. Planning PLN-2026-003 indice A of 17 March 2026 plans the delivery of window order BC-2026-009 on 30 March 2026 (task T07), but VanArsdel Menuiseries' e-mail of 18 March 2026 postpones it to Monday 20 April 2026 (week 17) because of a shortage of aluminium profiles at its supplier, and the minutes of site meeting n°3 (24 March 2026) record the same new date, with installation from 21 to 23 April 2026. Applying the resolution rule (authority, then recency), the latest information prevails: delivery on 20 April 2026, and planning indice A is out of date on this point.
notes: Asked by the site manager. S4 contradiction, scored on full/ only: once held-back/planning/PLN-2026-003_indice-B_planning-et-suivi-des-achats.xlsx is added (S10 time travel), indice B supersedes indice A and the answer becomes 20 April 2026 alone.

question: Which version of quote DEV-2026-014 is the current one, and what is its total including VAT compared with the version it replaced?
expected_answer: Indice B of 3 February 2026 is current: it cancels and replaces indice A of 20 January 2026. Indice B totals 44943,60 € including VAT (37843,00 € excluding VAT), against 41788,80 € including VAT (35214,00 € excluding VAT) for indice A, that is +3154,80 € including VAT (+2629,00 € excluding VAT). On 28 January 2026 the clients asked for a wider sliding bay window F1 (3,00 m instead of 2,40 m) and for floor tiling in the extension (item 7.3, 2040,00 € excluding VAT); the wall and lining areas were adjusted.
notes: Asked by the client. S1 supersession: indice B states that it cancels and replaces indice A; the contract is signed at the price of indice B.

question: For window order BC-2026-009, when are the windows now expected, how much of the order has been invoiced so far, and has an early payment of the balance been approved?
expected_answer: The windows are now expected on Monday 20 April 2026 (week 17) instead of 30 March 2026: VanArsdel Menuiseries postponed the delivery because of a shortage of aluminium profiles at its supplier (e-mail of 18 March 2026). question: Use the check-supplier-invoice skill: can Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 be paid as it stands?
expected_answer: Not as it stands. Invoice FA-2026-0217 of 16 March 2026 (order BC-2026-012, delivery note BL-2026-0391 of 13 March 2026) bills 10 pallets of hollow concrete blocks ZM-20450 at 79,20 € = 792,00 €, 30 bags of mortar ZM-31020 (237,00 €), 24 steel bars ZM-44108 (226,80 €), one lintel ZM-27340 (164,00 €) and the crane delivery (65,00 €): 1484,80 € excluding VAT, 296,96 € VAT at 20 %, 1781,76 € including VAT, due on 30 April 2026. The scanned delivery note prints 10 pallets as well, but the receiver wrote by hand '2 palettes manquantes' and 'reçu 8 pal.' (received by M. Ancelin): only 8 pallets were received; the other article lines match. Two pallets are billed but not delivered: 2 x 79,20 € = 158,40 € excluding VAT, plus 31,68 € VAT at 20 %, that is 190,08 € including VAT. The purchase tracking shows order BC-2026-012 at 1484,80 € excluding VAT, fully invoiced, and site meeting n°3 asked Bertrand Sauzède to check the invoice against the delivery note before payment, by 31 March 2026. Settle the two missing pallets with Zava Matériaux (delivery or a credit note of 158,40 € excluding VAT) before paying.
notes: skill=check-supplier-invoice; S5: 10 pallets billed, 8 received (handwritten, OCR evidence only); the amount at stake is derived, not printed: 2 x 79,20 € = 158,40 € HT, 190,08 € TTC.

question: Use the prepare-site-meeting skill to prepare site meeting no. 4 on 7 April 2026.
expected_answer: Brief for site meeting no. 4 (7 April 2026, 08:30, on site). Progress: site setup, earthworks, foundations and slab are complete (slab poured on 12 March 2026); the walls were at 70 % on 24 March 2026, against 20 % in planning PLN-2026-003 indice A of 17 March 2026; the roof structure and roofing, with the roof window of amendment n°1, start on 30 March 2026 (task T06). Deliveries: planning indice A still plans the windows of order BC-2026-009 on 30 March 2026 (task T07), but VanArsdel Menuiseries postponed them to 20 April 2026 (e-mail of 18 March 2026), with installation from 21 to 23 April 2026 according to the minutes; the most recent date prevails until the planning is revised. Open actions of meeting n°3: Inès Roux updates planning PLN-2026-003 to indice B (due 27 March 2026); Bertrand Sauzède checks Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 against the delivery note of 13 March 2026 before payment (due 31 March 2026); Damien Pradère confirms the electrical work of 7 April 2026 (due 31 March 2026); the Moreau family empties the kitchen cupboards (due 3 April 2026). Decisions to follow up: temporary closure of the openings with wooden panels on 7 April 2026 (D1), kitchen work brought forward to 7-10 April 2026 (D2), opening of the existing wall moved to 27-29 April 2026 (D3), handover kept on 15 May 2026 (D4). Gaps: no document after 24 March 2026 says whether these actions were done.
notes: skill=prepare-site-meeting; S4: planning indice A (windows on 2026-03-30, walls at 20 % on 2026-03-17) is out of date; the four actions of meeting n°3 have no later follow-up in the corpus.

question: Use the track-contract-amounts skill: what does the job cost in total after amendments, what has been paid so far and what remains to be paid?
expected_answer: Works contract of 10 February 2026 at the price of quote DEV-2026-014 indice B: 37843,00 € excluding VAT, 44943,60 € including VAT. Amendment n°1 of 10 March 2026: 1940,00 € excluding VAT, 388,00 € VAT, 2328,00 € including VAT, payable at handover, the 5 % retention applying to it as well. New total: 39783,00 € excluding VAT, 47271,60 € including VAT. Payment schedule of the contract (amounts including VAT): 30 % deposit 13483,08 € at signature; 30 % 13483,08 € at the end of the masonry (slab and walls); 25 % 11235,90 € when the extension is weathertight; 10 % 4494,36 € at handover; 5 % retention 2247,18 € released one year after handover if no reserves remain open. Paid so far: the deposit of 13483,08 €, paid at signature on 10 February 2026; no later payment appears in the documents. Still to pay: 47271,60 - 13483,08 = 33788,52 € including VAT, that is the three remaining instalments, the retention and the 2328,00 € of the amendment at handover; 5 % of the amendment (116,40 €) is held back with the retention, so 2363,58 € in total is released one year after handover.
notes: skill=track-contract-amounts; S2 and S3; derived, not printed: 33788,52 € TTC still to pay, 116,40 € retention on the amendment, 2363,58 € retention in total.
